system.description:
You touch a weapon, coating it in a vile poison. For the duration, [Weapon damage] this weapon deals becomes either Poison or Acid which you decide when this jutsu is cast.

Additionally, this weapon deals +1d6 damage twice per turn. Once per turn a creature damaged by this weapon must make a Constitution saving throw gaining a rank of Envenomed on a failed save.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is cast at C-Rank or higher, you can choose to instead inflict Corroded in place of Envenomed. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank or Higher, increase the bonus damage by 1d6. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or Higher, when cast its range becomes Self (15-Foot radius) and all willing creatures can select one weapon they have to be affected by this jutsu’s benefits. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank increase the ranks of Envenomed to 2.
